## Deviations and limits

- Pipeline: our Tier-B framework with the authors' GIN encoder (muben.model.gin: embedding + torch_geometric GIN jk=cat, global add pool) and featuriser; our output head, loss, loop, seeds (0/100/200), methods and metrics (n0067, n0068).
- The authors' QM7 split files hold 6,830 compounds, not the 7,160 of the paper's Table 4 (same files as Tier B).
- Random-split GIN results are an extension with no published target.
- MC dropout: dropout layers active, no normalisation layers in the GIN stack (torch_geometric default); BBP and SGLD act on the output head only, as for the other backbones.
